protestant.note: This is the common Protestant canon used as the product's default Christian reading track.

catholic.note: The Catholic canon includes additional deuterocanonical books; see official Catechism source.

orthodox.note: Eastern Orthodox canons vary by tradition; the Orthodox Church in America describes a longer Old Testament canon including books not in Protestant Bibles.

judaism.name: Tanakh
judaism.note: The Jewish Bible is organized as Torah, Nevi'im and Ketuvim; its book count and order differ from Protestant Old Testament presentations.

islam.note: The Qur'an is a distinct scripture; it references a number of biblical figures but is not a Christian canon.
